title: Visibility Actions
thesis: Visibility is a focused action that puts useful work in view, links it to your name, and gives others something concrete to understand and support.
carrier: One oversized contribution whose relationship to named audiences changes through visible action and response.
constraints: One dominant action and one visible consequence per beat
No progress bars, rails, traces, decorative dots, or scene numbers
No false UI, tiny boxed canvas, or redundant text
Existing narration, voice assets, and exact timing remain unchanged

milestones.state: Substantial work exists; visibility makes its contribution and potential legible.
Attention moves from the person to useful work, growth, and value for named audiences.
An intentional action places work in view, links a name, and builds reputation.
Six actions produce distinct audience-facing consequences.
A narrow, purposeful spotlight replaces visual noise and makes useful contribution readable.
Three tailored actions rehearse Share, Ask, and Offer with clear audiences.
One selected action is tested for 30 days and returns learning.
Practice clarifies future direction until support can be offered.
